metadata.description: Forge extensions for Claude Code: pipeline skill templates and the CodeMap annotation layer.

plugins.name: forge-pipeline-skills
plugins.description: Pipeline skill templates organized by stack × branching × deploy × verification. Base canonical set + per-profile overlays = drop-in bundle.

plugins.name: forge-codemap
plugins.description: codemap/1 — declare the couplings LSP cannot derive (cross-language contracts, flows, edit-time guards) as cm: annotations, and get them injected into the agent's context before it edits the file. Comment spam stops as a side effect.
